moodys.citation_text: Bond Buyer: 'Genesis HealthCare, Ohio, Downgraded to Ba2 by Moody's' — confirms Ba2 was reached at some point pre-window. The subsequent upgrade press release ('Moody's upgrades Genesis Healthcare System (OH) to Ba1 from Ba2; outlook revised to stable from positive') confirms Ba2 was the rating immediately before the upgrade. We carry Ba2/Stable on 2022-12-31.
moodys._warning: NOTE: Universe v2 labeled this obligor as 'Baa1' which appears to be incorrect; primary Moody's documentation shows speculative-grade Ba2 pre-upgrade and Ba1 post-upgrade (NOT investment-grade Baa1). This obligor is therefore NOT BBB-tier; it is sub-IG 'BB' tier.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Upgraded to Ba1 from Ba2; outlook revised to stable from positive
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Improved financial performance, broad footprint benefited from retail pharmacy strategy and outpatient medical center opened in 2023; ~$293M debt outstanding at FYE 2024.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: ResearchPool indexed Moody's press release: 'Moodys Ratings upgrades Genesis Healthcare System (OH) to Ba1; outlook revised to stable'. Full Moody's body not fetched (subscription). Becker's 'Genesis Healthcare System rating upgrades' coverage corroborates.
rating_actions_in_window._warning: Exact upgrade date not pinned. If upgrade fell AFTER 2025-03-31, the action is outside window and outcome class becomes AFFIRM_STABLE or AFFIRM_POSITIVE_OUTLOOK depending on prior outlook on 2025-03-31.

moodys.citation_text: Ba1/Stable per the indexed Moody's upgrade press release. Outlook revised from positive (prior) to stable (post-upgrade).

outcome_class_rationale: Moody's upgraded Ba2 -> Ba1 with outlook revised stable-from-positive during the window (subject to confirmation of exact upgrade date vs window end). This qualifies as UPGRADE. NOTE: This obligor is sub-IG (Ba1/Ba2), NOT BBB-tier as labeled in universe v2 — universe v2 'Baa1' label appears to be a transcription error of the speculative-grade Ba1.
